stance_basis: letter and attached comments call for ORV use to be presumed detrimental and prohibited on all public lands unless proven otherwise, with extensive specific objections to the draft EIS
summary: Michael McCloskey, as Executive Director of the Sierra Club, submitted a formal comment letter with detailed attached comments opposing the draft EIS for ORV implementation of Executive Order 11644. The Sierra Club argued that ORV use should be presumed harmful and all public lands closed to ORVs by default, opened only after study proves acceptable impact, and raised numerous specific objections to the draft's language, criteria, and emphasis on user-group benefits over resource protection.
complaint_summary: McCloskey transmits the Sierra Club's formal comments on the draft EIS for ORV implementation of Executive Order 11644, expressing appreciation for the opportunity to comment on this important environmental matter.

statement.text:
Enclosed herewith are the comments of the Sierra Club on the draft environmental impact statement for the Department of the Interior's implementation of Executive Order 11644 concerning the use of off road vehicles on public lands.
We appreciate having had this opportunity to submit comments on this important environmental matter.
Yours truly,
Michael McCloskey
Executive Director
Enclosure. MM:1kn
